label: Mixed Content No Longer Hidden By A Code Sample
desc: The mixed-content check skips resource tags that appear inside a code sample, since a documented example is not a real insecure load. It was matching the sample and the live tag to the same spot on the page, so a site that showed an example and then loaded that exact same resource insecurely further down was reported as clean. Each occurrence is now judged where it actually sits, so the real insecure load is reported and the code sample is still ignored.

label: Enumerable ID Check No Longer Stops At The First Match
desc: The check that spots easily guessable record numbers in a URL only looked at the first number it found. If that one was too large to be worth guessing, it stopped there and never looked at the rest of the address, so a small, easily guessable order or invoice number later in the same URL was missed entirely. It now checks every candidate in the address instead of giving up after the first.
